inspection_method: Read installed source files and METADATA over SSH; never imported torch_npu or initialized NPU.

kernel_csv.other_columns: Exporter may preserve additional CANN columns; analyzer selects exact required fields by name.

operator_csv.device_duration_semantics: Self/Total sum correlated kernel durations; Total includes descendant operators. They are not timeline unions.

trace_json.root: list of Chrome trace event objects
trace_json.device_link_rule: Paired cat=HostToDevice, ph=s/f flows; match ph=f endpoint to X by pid, tid, ts, following CANNFileParser.combine_acl_to_npu.
trace_json.coverage_limit: Only uniquely matched events are classified as device work automatically. No assumptions about undocumented process names/categories.

status: Parser preparation from installed source schema; fixtures are synthetic and do not constitute measured profiler results.
